name: fraud-detector
intended_use: Flags potentially fraudulent transactions for review by the fraud-detection system. It does not make final decisions; a human reviews flagged transactions.
training_data: Trained on the Week 4 card_activity feature group. Performance is only reliable for transaction patterns represented in that data.
limitations: Relies on an amount-threshold approach, so it can miss fraud that doesn't involve unusual amounts, and can flag legitimate high-value transactions as fraud.
ethical_considerations: False positives block legitimate transactions and inconvenience customers. False negatives let fraud through and cause financial loss. Both error types have real costs and should be monitored.
